scenario: SMS: 'Your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM. Call officer at 9876543210 immediately.'
explanation: Electricity boards never send disconnection threats with personal mobile numbers for same-night cutoffs.

scenario: SMS from AD-HDFCBK: 'INR 450.00 debited from A/C **1234 on 04-Nov-26. Not you? Call 18002026123. Never share OTP.'
explanation: Official bank debit alert containing masked account number, customer care toll-free, and an anti-fraud OTP warning.

scenario: WhatsApp message: 'Earn ₹3,000 daily from home just by liking YouTube videos. Deposit ₹500 for VIP task registration.'
explanation: Classic task/prepaid scam. No legitimate company charges money to assign simple video liking jobs.

scenario: Phone call: 'I am CBI Inspector Sharma on Skype. Illegal narcotics found in your parcel. You are placed under Digital Arrest.'
explanation: 'Digital Arrest' is a complete hoax. Indian law enforcement never conducts interrogations or arrests over Skype/video.

scenario: PhonePe notification: 'You received cashback ₹1,999! Enter your UPI PIN to accept credit to bank.'
explanation: You NEVER enter a UPI PIN to receive money. Entering your PIN always debits funds.

scenario: SMS from VK-INDPOST: 'Article IN9823102 out for delivery today. Delivery agent will arrive by 5 PM.'
explanation: Standard delivery notification with no phishing links or requests for money.

scenario: SMS: 'Dear SBI User, your YONO account is suspended. Update PAN immediately at http://bit.ly/sbi-pan-fix'
explanation: Banks never send shortened bit.ly links to update KYC or PAN.

scenario: SMS: 'Your traffic challan of ₹1000 is pending. Download echallan-payment.apk to clear before court notice.'
explanation: Traffic authorities never distribute APK files. Challans are only paid on echallan.parivahan.gov.in.

scenario: Automated call: 'Department of Telecom. Your SIM will be blocked in 2 hours due to illegal activities. Press 9.'
explanation: DoT/TRAI never makes automated disconnection calls to citizens.

scenario: SMS from AMAZON: 'Your OTP for Amazon login is 492019. Valid for 10 mins. Do not share with anyone.'
explanation: Genuine authentication OTP with clear confidentiality warning.

scenario: WhatsApp alert: 'PM Free Laptop Yojana 2026. All students can get free laptop by registering at www.pm-free-laptop.xyz'
explanation: Phishing scheme targeting student data using fake .xyz domains.

scenario: SMS: 'FedEx: Parcel detained due to unpaid customs fee of ₹1,420. Pay to UPI handle customs-clear@upi'
explanation: Customs duties are never collected via individual personal UPI IDs.

scenario: SMS from CP-SWIGGY: 'Your Swiggy delivery partner is on the way with your order #892182.'
explanation: Routine legitimate service update with official registered sender code.

scenario: Call from 'Bank Support': 'To reverse your accidental charge, please download AnyDesk from Play Store and tell me the code.'
explanation: AnyDesk allows scammers to mirror and control your screen to steal banking credentials.

scenario: SMS: 'Congratulations! You won ₹25,00,000 in KBC Jio Lucky Draw. Contact Rana Pratap on WhatsApp.'
explanation: You cannot win a lottery or raffle you never bought a ticket for.

scenario: Telegram message: 'Guaranteed 300% profit in 7 days on crypto and institutional stock trades. Deposit min ₹5,000.'
explanation: Guaranteed high returns are 100% Ponzi frauds.

scenario: SMS: 'Instant pre-approved loan of ₹5,00,000 without CIBIL or verification. Install fast-cash.apk now.'
explanation: Predatory illegal loan apps steal phone contacts and photos through side-loaded APKs.

scenario: SMS from AXISBK: 'Statement for your Axis Bank A/C ending 5678 for Oct 2026 is sent to your registered email.'
explanation: Standard banking informational notice with no solicitations.

scenario: Buyer on OLX: 'I have sent ₹10,000 via QR code. Scan this QR code and enter your UPI PIN to receive the payment.'
explanation: Scanning a QR code and entering your PIN transfers money out of your account, not into it.

scenario: SMS from APSPDCL: 'Dear Consumer 210948, your bill for Oct 2026 is ₹840 due on 12-Nov-2026. Pay safely at apspdcl.in.'
explanation: Authentic utility bill reminder pointing exclusively to the official state utility domain.
